ruling.recommended_action: Uphold the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee; no refund due. Note rider's claim that she arrived "a minute after cancellation" is consistent with the driver having lawfully waited out the 3 minutes before cancelling.
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: the chat contains only the driver's arrival notice and his cancellation notice; the complaint is a fee grievance. No threat, harassment, abuse or dangerous-driving allegation appears anywhere, so no SAFE-1/SAFE-2 escalation.

No-show analysis under NS-0 → NS-1: cancellation was by the driver on a contended rider no-show, and no-show threshold is not given in the record, so the default (iii) of >3 minutes applies (the record's free_wait_time is not a no-show threshold; NS-1). (i) Arrival was confirmed by driver tap: trip.driver_pressed_here_at = 17:19:15, matching chat message 17:19:25 "I'm here at the pickup point". (ii) At that tap the GPS fix (17:19:00, thinned 30 s grid) reads lat 1.283934, lon 103.850939, which is ~70 m from the pickup point (1.2840, 103.8513) — well within the 200 m data-layer radius, and the next two fixes (17:19:30, 17:20:00, 17:20:30, 17:21:00, 17:21:30, 17:22:00, 17:22:30, 17:22:55) stay stationary at ~1.28391–1.28394, 103.850941–103.850959, i.e. continuously inside the radius. (iii) Continuous wait from the 17:19:15 tap to the 17:22:55 cancellation = 3 min 40 s, exceeding the >3 min (≥3:01) requirement. The trace is continuous on the 30 s grid with no gap (largest gap 25 s), so NS-1's anti-gap proviso (G12) is not triggered. All three NS-1 elements are satisfied → the $6.61 rider cancellation fee stands, $4.50 of it to the driver, and the ruling is no_action with no amount.

Rider's complaint ("I came out a minute after the driver cancelled") does not defeat the fee: the fee is earned by the driver completing a lawful 3-minute wait, not by the rider's absence at that instant; NS-4's 3-minute grace period applies only to rider-initiated cancellations, and NS-8 (driver-late free cancellation) is not Ryde policy and there is no ETA field in any event.

No driver-side flag: the arrival tap took place within the 200 m pickup radius, so NS-2's fraudulent-tap flag condition is not met, and RD-6 is inapplicable (no route deviation of any kind — all fixes lie on the pickup approach corridor).

rejected_claims.reason: Rider says she came out a minute after the driver cancelled, so she should not be charged. The GPS trace shows the driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 17:19:15 inside the 200 m pickup radius and remained stationary there continuously until cancelling at 17:22:55 (3 min 40 s), satisfying NS-1 (i)(ii)(iii); the $6.61 fee is valid and NS-4's 3-minute grace period does not apply to a driver-initiated no-show cancellation.

Driver's statement that he 'waited over 3 minutes' is not taken on his word: it is independently corroborated by the GPS trace (stationary within the pickup radius from 17:19:00 to 17:22:55) and by his 17:22:45 cancellation message.
